context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the document-engine instructions from the published Rails Agent Skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Use this skill when writing or maintaining documentation for Rails engines.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: > **Hard gate:** All generated documentation MUST satisfy points 1, 3, and 4 above before proceeding to optional sections.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Validate against CHECKLIST.md: a checklist item **passes** when the docs contain a corresponding section with at least one copyable code example or explicit prose statement. A checklist item **fails** when the section is absent, incomplete, or lacks a concrete example. For each failing item: add the missing section or example, then re-run the checklist from the top. Do not finalize until all critical items pass.
